industry_implementation.summary: Official documentation explicitly treats IDF as a function of currently stored documents; current defaults are shard-wide, with optional corpus scoping. The local runtime examined here counts live physical sparse-vector points.
industry_implementation.scope_limit: Docs explain intended scoring, not a vendor exactly-once promise. Local and server deletion/index-maintenance semantics differ; do not extrapolate this local probe to cloud behavior.
